title: Grace's Phone Habit: $6,000 in 10 Years

scenes.say: $6,000 on phones in ten years. That's where Grace's habit is heading.
She buys a new $1,200 phone every two years, right when it comes out.
Over ten years, that's five phones and about $6,000, before any trade-in credit.
Watch the total jump every other year, like clockwork, even though the old phone still worked fine.
Now, what if she kept each phone for four years instead?
That's roughly $3,000 back, or about $25 a month she never misses.
Put that $25 a month aside, and the next phone is already paid for in cash.
A new battery and a case can keep an older phone going.
How old is your phone right now? Subscribe so you don't make this mistake on your next paycheck.
